title: Ralph MVP — Single Bash Script
description: Create /Users/admin/dev/ralph/ralph — a single bash file (~250 lines) that autonomously executes beads issues by looping Claude Code invocations. Deterministic outer loop; all intelligence in Claude Code inner loop. Source: ~/.claude/plans/wiggly-honking-gem.md
close_reason: All 5 subtasks complete. Ralph MVP is a 254-line bash script implementing deterministic outer loop with circuit breaker.

title: Script foundation: header, config, utilities, arg parsing, prereqs, early-exit
description: Create ralph script with sections 1-6: shebang + strict mode, default configuration (MAX_TASKS, MAX_LOOPS, TIMEOUT_MINUTES, SCOPE, STATE_FILE), utility functions (log, load_state, save_state), argument parsing (--dry-run, --max-tasks, --max-loops, --timeout, --scope, --status, --reset, --help), prerequisite checks (jq, bd, claude, gtimeout/timeout, .beads/), and early-exit handlers (--status prints state, --reset clears state). ~90 lines.

title: Task selection: pick_next_task and get_task_details functions
description: Implement pick_next_task() — runs bd ready --json --limit 20, uses jq to skip epics (issue_type != epic), applies --scope pattern via jq test(), returns first match ID. Implement get_task_details() — runs bd show ID --json, extracts .issue.title, .issue.description, .issue.notes, .issue.acceptance_criteria, .issue.design with jq. ~35 lines.

title: Main loop: Claude invocation, response parsing, circuit breaker, task outcomes
description: Implement the core outer loop: exit condition checks (max_tasks, max_loops, circuit OPEN), task picking with current_task retry for EXIT_SIGNAL=false, claim via bd update --status in_progress, prompt construction from template + task details, Claude invocation with timeout (claude -p PROMPT --output-format json --max-turns 50 --verbose), response parsing (extract .result with jq, extract RALPH_STATUS block, parse STATUS/FILES_MODIFIED/EXIT_SIGNAL/SUMMARY), circuit breaker state machine (CLOSED->HALF_OPEN at no_progress>=2, HALF_OPEN->OPEN at no_progress>=3, recovery on progress), and task outcome handling (COMPLETE: bd close + bd set-state verified=needs-review, BLOCKED: release claim, EXIT_SIGNAL false: retry same task). ~100 lines.

title: Exit summary and cleanup trap
description: Implement cleanup() function called via trap on EXIT. Prints session summary: tasks completed, total loops, circuit breaker state, exit reason, bnr reminder. Also cleans up temp files (Claude JSON output). Set EXIT_REASON variable before each exit point so cleanup knows why. ~15 lines.

title: Verify ralph MVP: dry-run, status, reset, single task, circuit breaker, line count
description: Verify all acceptance criteria from RALPH_MVP_PROMPT.md Definition of Done: (1) ralph --dry-run shows next task, (2) ralph --max-tasks 1 picks task and invokes Claude correctly, (3) ralph --scope filters to matching issues, (4) circuit breaker halts after 3 no-progress loops, (5) exit summary prints correctly, (6) ralph --reset clears state, (7) script under 300 lines. Test in a project with .beads/ directory.
close_reason: All acceptance criteria verified: dry-run, scope, reset, status, epic filtering, prereq checks, exit summary, 254 lines (under 300). Live Claude invocation test deferred.
